items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to sugar, with a walk after dinner associated with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller. Walking 10 to 19 minutes after a meal got most of the gain, with a rise about 17.5 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep meal times steady around your shifts
items.text: You work nights, so clock-time rules about late dinners don't fit you. Keep your main meal at the same point in your waking day.

rejected.text: Keep your main meal at the same point in your waking day, as clock-time rules don't fit your schedule. This helps you establish a consistent routine.
